column1: # Executables/paths that were migrated into nftban-core/nftband subcommands and
# no longer exist as standalone binaries. Any EXECUTABLE reference (a call or a
# path assignment) in shell/Go/systemd/packaging source is a migration-
# completeness defect — the consumer was left pointing at a dead entrypoint
# while the implementation moved. This is the guard the geoban case needed:
# GeoIP moved into `nftban-core geoip` but nftban_geoban.sh kept resolving
# bin/.real/nftban-geoip-x86_64, so country-blocking silently died fleet-wide.
